name: Rachit
description: I'm Rachit Makwana, a GSoC 2026 contributor with FOSSASIA, working on Eventyay. I love exploring new technologies, solving real-world problems, and building things that make a difference. I'm passionate about open source, collaborating with developers worldwide, and turning ideas into impactful projects—one commit at a time. One of my biggest dreams is to join Google someday and build technology that impacts millions.
